requirements.text: Expose public bounded read inspection, host permit and retirement interfaces without private resource handles.
Bind original claim run/plan/input/request/operation/correlation identities, exact source bytes, host/runtime root and declared installed-provider pins.
Use the real public Argus reader and verify a terminal lifecycle with every acquiring intent explicitly compensated by released cleanup; preserve recorded and assessed verdicts.
Reject live ownership, open writers, unknown cleanup, missing/duplicate/inconsistent lifecycle facts, corruption, changing sources and unsupported shapes before any retirement.
Require a finite exact-inspection host-only recovery permit; imported XDL, caller records, paths and PIDs grant no authority.
Persist a separate immutable durable retirement record atomically and idempotently; preserve original claim and Argus bytes.

Allow new Start in the same root only after revalidating all predecessor retirements against current source and host/provider pins; original read remains unknown and repeated old Start never dispatches.
Serialize with original public root owner, reject concurrent/busy/active registrations and bound files, records, bytes, diagnostics and permits.
Inspection and retirement perform no provider callbacks, process signals, container mutation, message publication or device stimulation.
Preserve existing constructor/API behavior when recovery is unconfigured, SDK regression and native X-COM evidence boundaries.
Retain exact candidate/environment/commands/results, explicit REF-002 allocations and separate review findings; user acceptance precedes main/dependency integration.

Demonstrate actual owned-child normal stop, failed/cancelled startup compensation, owner loss, permitted retirement and a distinct new run in the original registration; complete Studio live acceptance remains downstream.

tasks.description: specification, requirements, design and read-only consistency
public recovery types, source inspection and verifier
host permits, durable retirement and Start fences
separate review, repair and exact repeated checks
explicit user acceptance, exact main and assembled verification
Studio admitted dependency and original-root complete live workflow
